approach: Add athena-core/src/code_health.rs with pure, fixture-testable functions and Athena entry points. measure() walks crates/**/*.rs, parses with syn (full+visit, proc-macro2 span-locations), counts production lines (non-blank, non-comment lines outside #[cfg(test)] item spans), finds the longest fn (free, impl, trait, nested), and joins to records: landings in 7 days touching the file, and citations (rejected/failed jobs touching the file plus findings naming the path). Test run time comes from the 'test' check of the latest landed verification (labelled unknown if absent). evaluate() uses constants: lines>2000; longest fn>200; lines>1500 with >=5 weekly landings. Athena::run_code_health(ui) measures, queues one structural-pass request per breaching file unless an open request carries the marker 'Structural pass: <path>', then queues the design review when due (>=10 landings since the last review request, none open; first-ever baseline stored in a state-dir file so history does not fire). Requests use channel steward via Committer under the repository lock. Hooks: Athena::note_finished (steward.rs, after guards, tick untouched) and the Landed branch of land_pr (gh.rs). Each emits a ui line; zero measured files is reported as such, never healthy; errors show as ui lines and never fail the job. StatusView gains code_health, filled read-only by Athena::status; display::status renders the table.

decisions.choice: Measure function length with syn 2 (full, visit) plus proc-macro2 span-locations in athena-core/Cargo.toml; record in docs/decisions.md.
decisions.reason: buy-first: syn is maintained and already in Cargo.lock; it handles nested fns, strings and raw strings that a scan miscounts, and the numbers drive automatic queueing.

rejected.why: Miscounts braces in strings, comments and char literals; silent errors.
Much heavier than needed for line spans.

decisions.choice: Thresholds are private constants in code_health.rs, shown in the table and recorded in decisions.md.
decisions.reason: Config fields are out of scope; mechanism rule wants enforcement in code.

decisions.choice: Cadence and dedup derived from records and open requests; baseline count in a state-dir file for the first review.
decisions.reason: Both hooks can run for one job without double counting; criterion 6 holds.

rejected.why: Double counts when both hooks fire.
A missed check loses the review.
Needs athena-data schema change, not a deliverable.

decisions.choice: Hook note_finished and land_pr Landed branch as separate calls; leave steward::tick alone.
decisions.reason: Matches the reading and out-of-scope limit.

decisions.choice: Queued text has its own acceptance bullets, a 'Priority: high' line for the review, and a marker line for structural passes.
decisions.reason: athena plan refuses items without bullets; marker enables dedup.

rejected.option: Reference a design-review role or request dn2e
rejected.why: No such role; reading says not to depend on it.

files.purpose: Measurement, thresholds, types, request queueing, Athena::run_code_health, tests.
pub mod code_health and doc line.
code_health field on StatusView filled in Athena::status.
Call the check after Landed in land_pr; test.
Call the check from note_finished; test; tick untouched.
Only a comment if needed; otherwise unchanged.
Render the code-health table in status; test.
Record thresholds, syn vs scan, cadence.

steps: Read checks.rs for the test check name and the gh.rs land_pr / test_support fixtures.
Add syn and proc-macro2 to athena-core/Cargo.toml; update Cargo.lock; check cargo tree.
Write code_health.rs measurement, record joins and evaluate().
Add request builders, dedup, cadence with baseline file, run_code_health with summary line.
Write tests for criteria 1-6 including no-files and parse-failure cases.
Hook note_finished and land_pr; add hook tests and confirm they fail with the call removed.
Add code_health to StatusView and Athena::status; render in display::status with tests.
Write CHANGELOG entry and decisions.md record.
Run cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings and cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Line-count definition differs from the brief's 2000.
risks.mitigation: One definition (non-blank, non-comment, outside cfg(test)) in the module header, used by measure and tests; numbers shown in the table.

risks.risk: Check slows or fails a landing.
risks.mitigation: Errors are caught and shown as ui lines, never returned.

risks.risk: syn fails to parse a file or no files found.
risks.mitigation: Unparsed files are listed as unmeasured; zero measured prints 'no files measured', never healthy.
Hold the repository lock while deciding and committing; re-read records inside it; dedup by marker.

risks.risk: Nested run or status call writes requests.
risks.mitigation: Skip when nested; status path is read-only.

risks.risk: Queued text carries personal data or machine paths.
risks.mitigation: Constant template with only repo-relative paths and numbers interpolated.

demonstrations.method: Unit test with tempdir fixture .rs (known fn lengths plus a #[cfg(test)] mod) and in-memory JobRecords (landings inside/outside 7 days, rejected jobs, a finding naming the path).
demonstrations.observes: Exact production line count excluding test module, exact longest fn, 7-day landings (old excluded), citation count.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without measurement, lines include the test module, longest fn is wrong, landings and citations are zero.

demonstrations.method: Fixtures: 2001-line file; 201-line fn; 1501 lines with 5 landings (and with 4); small file.
demonstrations.observes: Each breach reported with its reason; small file and 4-landing case not flagged.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing threshold leaves its breach unreported, or the under-threshold file is flagged.

demonstrations.method: Scratch repo with a breaching file; run_code_health twice, then with an open request, then with a closed one.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly one steward-channel request naming the file and numbers; second run and open-request run queue none; closed request does not block.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without dedup, repeat runs queue duplicates; without queueing, none is queued.

demonstrations.method: Records with a prior review request, then 9 and 10 landed jobs after it; run the check each time.
demonstrations.observes: No review after 9; exactly one after 10 with Priority::High; none added while open.
demonstrations.fails_without: Wrong cadence fires at the wrong count or at lower priority.

demonstrations.method: Read the queued design-review text in a test.
demonstrations.observes: Text names code-health table, most changed and most broken files since last review, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops, and a short design note with proposed changes as a design-only job.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the full text the job lacks what to review or produce.

demonstrations.method: Records with 25 landings and no review request; check, then 9 more landings, then the 10th.
demonstrations.observes: First check queues nothing and writes the baseline; review fires only at 10 landings after the baseline.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the baseline, existing history queues a review at once.

demonstrations.method: land_pr fixture in gh.rs and a note_finished test, each with a recording Ui and a breaching file; producer confirms each fails with the hook call removed; nested run does not run it.
demonstrations.observes: Ui shows the 'code health:' line and a structural-pass request exists after each path; steward-count unchanged by the check.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing the hook call from land_pr or note_finished removes the ui line and request, failing the test.

demonstrations.method: display.rs test builds StatusView with CodeHealth (two files, one over, test run time) and renders display::status; core test that Athena::status fills the field.
demonstrations.observes: Output has each file's lines, longest fn, weekly landings, citations, thresholds, over marker, test run time; zero files says none measured.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the field and renderer the table text is absent.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks Athena runs. Producer also confirms the gate is live: the new tests are included in cargo test, so a failing assertion or a clippy warning (e.g. an unused new item) makes the command exit nonzero.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three exit 0, with the new code_health, gh, steward and display tests listed as passing.
demonstrations.fails_without: Unformatted code fails fmt; any warning in new code fails clippy -D warnings; any broken or failing new test fails cargo test, so the command exits nonzero.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of the two files.
demonstrations.observes: CHANGELOG Unreleased entry for check, status table, 10-landing review; decisions.md entry with the three thresholds, syn-vs-scan call, 10-landing cadence and baseline rule.
